source.text: The Buyer shall pay each invoice that is correct and undisputed within thirty-five (35) days from the date appearing on the invoice

6.1 The Parties agree that the Ubiquiti UniFi 6 Enterprise Access Point shall be supplied to the Buyer at a fixed rate of Pakistani Rupees thirty-eight thousand five hundred (PKR 38,500) for each unit, and the Vendor shall ensure that no invoice raised under this Agreement for that product states a unit rate higher than the agreed amount.
